# Dream Come True

**Status: in progress.**


!!! warning "In progress"
    `dream_come_true` does not have complete run artifacts yet, so this page carries no numbers.
    It will join the benchmark tables once a full evaluated run lands in `examples/`.

The idea: a reblocker whose proposed roads are the **desire lines people already walk** —
detected from the ground truth of use, not synthesized from geometry.

* **Phase 1 (shipped as [`osm_footpaths`](osm_footpaths.md)):** pull the informal footpath
  network from OpenStreetMap, where Humanitarian OSM teams have already digitized worn paths
  from imagery. This delivered a working as-built baseline with no ML and full offline
  reproducibility (a committed per-region OSM snapshot).
* **Phase 2 (planned):** detect desire lines directly from satellite imagery, slotting into the
  same `DesireLineSource` seam Phase 1 defined. Deriving desire lines from cheap signals
  (imagery heuristics, building-point geometry) was probed and found not to match OSM's
  human-mapped network — see `docs/superpowers/notes/2026-07-15-desire-line-detection.md` in the
  repository — so this phase is where the real detector work lives.

Design and plan documents live in the repository under `docs/superpowers/specs/` and
`docs/superpowers/plans/` (`2026-07-15-dream-come-true-*`).
